record.question: Under Section 55 of the Indian Contract Act a vendor has no right to make time of the essence of the contract unless:
options: The vendor is able, ready and willing to proceed to completion

When the vendor purports to make time of the essence of the contract, the purchaser must be guilty of such default as to entitle the vendor to rescind the contract, subject to it being done by a reasonable notice
